name: TrustRAG
description: An open reliability workbench for retrieval-augmented generation. Atomic claim decomposition, batch entailment audit, and bounded closed-loop self-healing.

entries.description: Versioned REST API under /api/v1. GET /api/v1/health is unauthenticated; all other routes require a bearer token from POST /api/v1/auth/login.
